probe_finding: Definition (author @throwthedamball, read 2026-10-15): DESTROY RATE — how often a QB ruins a play the defense did NOT disrupt: an inaccurate throw, a sack taken, or a negative scramble with no disruptor present. Where C-311 (create rate) credits a QB for beating disruption, destroy rate debits him for unforced failure — the two together separate 'the defense beat him' from 'he beat himself'. Role in-engine: the unforced-error side of QB evaluation; a high destroy rate is a trait the market's raw EPA line can hide inside team context, which is exactly the kind of through-the-lines read the reasoning layer exists to make.
